events.title: Demo Update 0.0.14
events.summary: Dear Chefs! You asked, we delivered. There's a bunch of new changes for your convenience: Dumpling Mastery. Every dumpling you fold by hand counts toward mastering its base. The higher your mastery, the better your auto-cooking comes out and the bigger the tips. One thing we would rather say than have you find out: this does not change how stars are awarded while you cook. Steps are graded exactly as before. Mastery is about what happens when you let the kitchen handle it. Dumplings have names.

events.title: Same Dough, Different Rules
events.summary: Pierogi, varenyky, knedle. If you haven't spent much time in Eastern European kitchens, these three probably read as one thing: dough, filling, boil. They're really not. Pierogi Lisa grew up on these. Grandma's recipe, which means it's the correct recipe and we don't take questions. Thin, stretchy dough - flour, water, egg - rolled out and pinched shut into a half-moon. Get the seal wrong and your filling goes swimming and you're left holding an empty pocket.
